description: Live priority-fee recommendation for current congestion: low, medium and high tiers in micro-lamports per compute unit with estimated confirmation times, plus min, max and average. Example: {"network":"mainnet-beta"}

network.description: Cluster to query: "mainnet-beta" (real funds; the default) or "devnet" (test network). Optional.
